question: In humans the neck is joined by the head by which of the following joints?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Pivotal joint**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• pivot joint

 
 
• The pivot joint is the joint that is present in the area where the neck joins the head.
 
• Pivot joints, also known as rotary joints,
 
• Pivot joints permit axial rotation.
 
• The moving bone rotates within a ring formed by the concave surface of a second bone and an adjoining ligament.​
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Ball and socket joint
 
 
• The ball and socket joint or spheroid joint can be defined as a synovial joint in which the ball-shaped surface of one rounded bone fits with the cup-like depression of another bone in the body. 
 
• There are only two ball and socket joints in human body – one in the shoulder and the other in the hip
 
 
 
• The hinge joint is commonly referred to as the knee.__
 
 
• Hinge Joint is a joint in the human body that serves motion in one plane.
 
• It is a common class of synovial joint that includes the:-
 
• Ankle
 
• Knee
 
• Finger Joints 
 
• Toe Joints​
 
 
 
• **Fixed Joint:**
 
 
• There are some bones in our head that are joined together at some joints. The bones cannot move at these joints. Such joints are called fixed joints.
 
• For example - The joint between the head and upper jaw, cannot be moved.
